_comment: Advisories the audit gate tolerates. Each entry needs a reason and a review date. Remove an entry as soon as a fixed version is installable; scripts/audit-gate.mjs warns when an entry no longer matches anything.

advisories.reason: ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs. Affects every picomatch release up to 4.0.7, the newest, so no fixed version exists. Reached only through build tooling (@angular/build, vite, sass via @parcel/watcher); `npm audit --omit=dev` is clean, so nothing in the served bundle is affected.
